goal: No project, objective, blocker, commitment, approval, or required operator action is allowed to silently rot.
problem_statement: MIM/TOD can detect stale, stuck, blocked, or below-threshold work, but detected items still risk becoming passive status text unless every item is assigned a resolution lane, next action, aging policy, and terminal outcome.

examples: Studio page action available to MIM
resolution_hierarchy.rule: Resolve automatically when MIM has enough context and app/tool permission.
Dispatch TOD with bounded acceptance criteria and required validation evidence.

examples: TOD failed or stalled after evidence-backed attempt
resolution_hierarchy.rule: Escalate with a continuity brief, failed attempts, files touched, commands run, and exact blocker.
Track the dependency with source, requested action, age, reminder schedule, and fallback path.
Ask Dave only after MIM/TOD/Codex/external lanes cannot resolve it, or when policy requires Dave's approval.

example.what_needs_dave: Approve account manager access to commission totals.
example.reason: Rep commission totals are confidential and require owner-level approval.

success_criteria: Every open item has owner, state, next action, age, and reminder policy.
No item remains in passive needs_attention or blocked status without a resolution lane.
MIM tries self-resolution first when it has app control or sufficient context.
TOD receives implementation/blocker work before Codex unless policy or capability evidence says otherwise.
Codex escalation packets include continuity brief and failed lower-lane attempts.
Dave-needed items always include reason, choices, impact, and reminder schedule.
A daily digest can be generated from the follow-through queue.

relationship_to_development_continuity.reason: Continuity answers what was learned. Follow-through answers what still needs to happen.

first_implementation_slice: Create follow-through objective artifact and operator summary.
Add or extend Studio Projects/Training data model so each item has owner, state, next action, age, resolution lane, and Dave-needed contract.
Create a Follow Through queue or dashboard section.
Wire MIM chat responses so needs_attention/stuck/blocked replies include actionable resolution steps.
Validate on live cases: Lab servo COM5 lock, Studio reports data request, Account Manager approval, AgentMIM forum graphics, TOD local PowerShell interruptions.
training_assertion: MIM should treat in-app controls as actions it can manage or route, not as manual chores for Dave, unless authentication, browser security, physical hardware safety, or policy prevents autonomous action.
